senses.gloss: मूल (1) the root of the teeth given as the place of origin for the letter र् in the Rk Tantra : cf. रेफस्तु दन्त्यो दन्तमूले वा. R. T. 8; (2) the main instrutment of the utterance of letters known as मूलकरण or अनुप्रदान.
मूलप्रकृति the original base of the word used in language; the root and the praatipadika; the word परमप्रकृति , is also used in the same sense.
